label: Samsung Link Cell indoor 5G mmWave small cell
description: Integrated indoor 5G mmWave small cell with baseband, radio and antenna in one unit, connected to the virtualized CU by a single Cat.6 Ethernet backhaul instead of a fibre fronthaul. That 1 Gigabit Ethernet port is the only modelled interface - the mmWave air interface is not a Wi-Fi radio, so no wireless port is declared.
